snippet.title: MASAKRE - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for MASAKRE, a grim and dynamic action RPG where everything belongs to chaos and madness. Prove your superiority and attain enlightenment in a world where everything seeks to destroy you. Fallen civilizations, terrifying gods, and utter darkness will stand in your path. MASAKRE is coming soon to PC (Steam).
